name: Bingles Blastenheimer
summary: On Loch Modan’s southeastern shore, Bingles Blastenheimer waits beside the wreck of his flying machine. Stranded among troggs and beasts, the gnomish aviator needs his tools and parts back.

sections.title: A Rough Landing
sections.body: Bingles Blastenheimer took his customized flying craft into the skies, but bringing it down safely proved harder than lifting off. His gyrocopter malfunctioned and crashed on the Loch’s southeastern shore. Bingles survived, but the machine broke apart. Far from Ironforge, he stays near the wreck, wary of hungry crocolisks and hostile troggs. Troggs from a nearby island stole his tools and Blastencapper explosives, and he asks passing travelers to recover them.

aliases: who is the gnome by the lake
faq.answer: Bingles Blastenheimer is a gnomish pilot and tinkerer, stranded after his flying machine crashed on Loch Modan’s southeastern shore.

faq.q: What happened to his flying machine?
faq.answer: Bingles crashed his gyrocopter into the Loch. Troggs from a nearby island attacked him and stole his tools and Blastencapper explosives.

faq.q: Why hasn't Bingles returned to town?
faq.answer: Bingles is stranded without his gyrocopter, and troggs from a nearby island stole his tools and Blastencapper explosives. He wants them back for the movement to retake Gnomeregan, so he waits by the wreck for someone to recover them.

faq.q: Where does Bingles end up after his craft is fixed?
faq.answer: Bingles remains at his crash site on the Loch’s southeastern shore, waiting for travelers to recover his missing supplies.

angles.text: As a gnome, you share Bingles’s drive to take gnomish invention into the skies, even when mechanical failure brings a hard landing.
As an engineer, you know the trouble of losing custom spanners and gadgets to troggs after a flight goes wrong.
